title: US stocks with the highest debt-to-equity ratios: Birkenstock and peers
summary: Investing.com -- The US market’s highest-leverage names are posting debt-to-equity ratios from 1,000% to over 15,000%, with some carrying more debt than their entire market cap and holding less than 5% of capital in cash.
